title: Accelerating Min-Max Optimization via Power-Law Stepsizes
abstract: arXiv:2606.01764v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We revisit the convergence guarantees of the Extragradient (EG) method for unconstrained biaffine min-max optimization. It is known that EG with a fixed stepsize achieves a $\Theta(T^{-1/2})$ last-iterate convergence rate, which is slower than the optimal $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1})$ rate attainable by incorporating additional mechanisms such as anchoring. Motivated by recent advances showing that dynamic stepsizes alone can significantly accelerate gradient descent, we ask whether dynamic stepsizes can similarly accelerate the last-iterate convergence of EG.   We present the first positive result in this direction. Specifically, we provide a deterministic dynamic stepsize schedule that accelerates the convergence rate of EG to $\mathcal{O}(T^{-2/3+\varepsilon})$ for any $\varepsilon > 0$. translated_title: 通过幂律步长加速极小极大优化
translated_abstract: 我们重新审视了外梯度法在无约束双仿射极小极大优化问题中的收敛保证。已知使用固定步长的外梯度法可实现 Θ(T^{-1/2}) 的最后迭代收敛速率，这慢于通过引入锚定等额外机制所能达到的最优 O(T^{-1}) 速率。受近期研究进展的启发——这些进展表明仅凭动态步长就能显著加速梯度下降——我们探究动态步长是否也能类似地加速外梯度法的最后迭代收敛。我们给出了该方向上的首个正面结果。具体而言，我们提供了一个确定性的动态步长调度，将外梯度法的收敛速率加速至 O(T^{-2/3+ε})（对任意 ε > 0）。我们还证明了当外梯度法的外推步和更新步使用相同步长时，该速率几乎是紧的。随后我们表明，允许不同的步长……
tldr: 本文给出了首个正面结果，证明仅使用幂律动态步长即可将外梯度法的最后迭代收敛速率从 Θ(T^{-1/2}) 加速至 O(T^{-2/3+ε})，并证明在外推步与更新步共用同一同步长时该速率几乎是紧的。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first positive result that dynamic power-law stepsizes alone accelerate the last-iterate convergence of the Extragradient method from Θ(T^{-1/2}) to O(T^{-2/3+ε}), and shows this rate is nearly tight when the extrapolation and update steps share the same stepsize.
